verifiedRecords.theorem: Corollary 3.4 and parameter-preserving matching reductions immediately following it; Table 5 footnote
verifiedRecords.notes: Transfer: with every edge weighted 1, optimum weight equals maximum matching cardinality, without overhead. With polynomial preprocessing, exact fast queries cannot coexist with truly sub-√m amortized updates. On dense graphs this excludes truly sublinear-in-n updates. This is neither an Ω(n) theorem nor an approximation lower bound.
